title: Cheat Sheet: Cloud SQL vs AlloyDB vs Spanner vs Firestore vs Bigtable — D5
purpose: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
routing_rationale: Choosing a Google Cloud database requires systematic constraint mapping: Relational vs NoSQL? Single-region vs Multi-region? Read-heavy caching vs Petabyte write-heavy streaming? Knowing the exact boundaries prevents costly architectural re-platforming.

nodes.label: Relational SQL Required?
nodes.detail: Existing schema requires strict relational integrity and complex multi-table joins.

nodes.label: NoSQL / High Volume Required?
nodes.detail: Massive horizontal scale, document hierarchy, or sub-10ms key-value lookups.

nodes.label: Cloud Spanner Multi-Region
nodes.detail: Horizontal scaling, multi-region external consistency, limitless storage capacity.

nodes.label: Cloud SQL / AlloyDB
nodes.detail: Drop-in PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server compatibility; automatic HA failover.

nodes.label: Cloud Firestore
nodes.detail: Real-time client synchronization, offline mobile cache, flexible JSON documents.

nodes.label: Cloud Bigtable
nodes.detail: Sustains millions of writes/sec; ideal for IoT, financial tickers, and telemetry data.

steps.title: Relational Routing
steps.action: Evaluates relational scaling: Cloud Spanner for global horizontal scale; Cloud SQL for regional workloads.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents over-provisioning Spanner when Cloud SQL satisfies requirements.

steps.title: NoSQL Routing
steps.action: Evaluates NoSQL: Firestore for client-facing mobile documents; Bigtable for raw telemetry scale.
steps.why_traversal: Ensures database performance matches data access patterns.

scenarios.label: Selected Firestore for High-Throughput IoT Stream
scenarios.root_cause: Ingested 100,000 writes/sec into single Firestore document; hit hard 1 write/sec per document limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Writes blocked with RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors; massive billing overrun.
scenarios.recovery: Select Cloud Bigtable for high-throughput streaming writes exceeding 10,000 QPS.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
